source_caption_text:
We’ll never see all these artists on the same song ever again 😭😭😭

More than a decade after its release, “F**kin’ Problems” has crossed 1 billion streams on Spotify 💿🔥

A$AP Rocky’s 2012 track brought together Drake, 2 Chainz and Kendrick Lamar, and became one of the biggest hits from his debut album Long.Live.A$AP. It peaked at No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and now has more than 1 billion Spotify streams. 

2 Chainz recently unboxed his Spotify plaque and joked about getting the lineup back together: “You can’t even pay a billion dollars for these people to be on the same record again” 😭

Would you want another song with all four of them? 👀
